paragraphs: R' Kruspedai (without further designation): see the entry R' Krispi.[^1]

notes.text: The heading supplies Kruspedai son of Shabtai; the body has Kruspedai without further designation and points to Krispi. All four personal titles are abbreviated and retained as R'; distinct names and the undesignated qualifier remain.
